title: Exchange of protocol configuration options in other messages

entities.name: Protocol Configuration Options IE
entities.description: Information element used to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events between UE and network.

entities.name: Extended Protocol Configuration Options IE
entities.description: Extended version of the protocol configuration options IE used for transmitting protocol data between UE and network.

entities.name: MSISDN Notification Procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed during EPS bearer context activation to notify MSISDN information as specified in 3GPP TS 24.008.

entities.name: EPS Bearer Context Activation
entities.description: Message used for activating EPS bearer contexts, which can carry protocol configuration options.

entities.name: EPS Bearer Context Deactivation
entities.description: Message used for deactivating EPS bearer contexts, which can carry protocol configuration options.

entities.name: EPS Bearer Context Modification
entities.description: Message used for modifying EPS bearer contexts, which can carry protocol configuration options.

entities.name: PDN Connectivity Request
entities.description: Message used for requesting PDN connectivity, which can carry protocol configuration options.

entities.name: PDN Disconnect Request
entities.description: Message used for requesting PDN disconnection, which can carry protocol configuration options.

entities.name: Bearer Resource Allocation Request
entities.description: Message used for requesting bearer resource allocation, which can carry protocol configuration options.

entities.name: Bearer Resource Modification Request
entities.description: Message used for requesting bearer resource modification, which can carry protocol configuration options.

entities.name: PDN Connectivity Reject
entities.description: Message used for rejecting PDN connectivity requests, which can carry protocol configuration options.

entities.name: PDN Disconnect Reject
entities.description: Message used for rejecting PDN disconnect requests, which can carry protocol configuration options.

entities.name: Bearer Resource Allocation Reject
entities.description: Message used for rejecting bearer resource allocation requests, which can carry protocol configuration options.

entities.name: Bearer Resource Modification Reject
entities.description: Message used for rejecting bearer resource modification requests, which can carry protocol configuration options.
